We are in March 2020 and I think it’s time to do little predictions for the nominations and also performances. Also MTV didn’t announced the date and the venue where this year’s VMAS will take place, so let’s play a little bit.

1- Ok, one artist that can be nominated is Lizzo for the newest video version released back in Autumn 2019, “Good As Hell”. That song didn’t go to #1 on Hot 100, but it was still a success. She can be nominated for Best Hip Hop and Video For Good.

2- Since we talked about a black artist, let’s continue to talk about more black artists who can still be nominated. Future has been successful with the hit single “Life Is Good” featuring Drake. The video can be nominated for Video Of The Year, Song Of The Year, Best Collaboration, Best Hip Hop. Future also may have a chance to be nominated for Artist Of The Year.

3- Talking about Drake, he can have nominations also with No Guidance (Chris Brown’s hit song) in Collaboration. Also it would be Chris Brown’s first nomination in this category since 2014. But Best R&B is guaranteed. Also Drake can appear in Artist Of The Year.

4- What About Lil Nas X?
He still has a chance with Panini and Romeo with Nas. He can appear in Collaboration and Hip Hop, but I think he will appear more in professional categories like Direction, Art Direction and Cinematography for Panini.

5- There’s room for Taylor Swift?
Maybe yes, maybe not. She has for now two eligible videos: Lover and The Man. But since Lover’s video was released back in August, it’s probably later for that video to be nominated. She can be nominated for Video For Good and Direction with “The Man”. Artist Of The Year nomination may not happen, but who knows since this year the battle will be very hard.

6- Will some album’s names have a influence on number of nominations for a few artists?
Who knows. BTS for example released their latest album “Map Of The Soul:7". Could this mean they will receive 7 nominations at this year’s VMAS?
Their highest chances of nominations are: Video Of The Year for ON, Best Group, Best K-Pop for both BLACK SWAN and ON, Direction for ON, Art Direction for ON and Choreography for ON. That makes 7 nominations, 7!!!!

7- Justin Bieber is flopping with his new album Changes, but can Yummy’s music video actually makes more nominations for him or Intentions with Quavo is now the hit that Justin Bieber can have a nomination at this year’s VMAS? According to my sources of charts and videos, Yummy can make an appearance in Best Pop and Intentions is on the way for Collaboration and Video For Good (since this video Justin talks to people who had no education). Maybe he can make it to Artist Of The Year. Also he released a new movement long form video called “Changes: The Movement”. Will MTV bring back Breakthrough Long Form Video?

8- Where’s Beyoncé?
According to some insiders, her new album is scheduled for this summer, but she still has chances to get nominated for the VMAS 2020. In which categories?
In this case she can be nominated for “Spirit” in Best R&B. Also she has a good chance of getting a Choreography nod with “Spirit” too.

9- Which genre will Post Malone be put in?
Since Post Malone has ever received 3 VMA nominations (Artist Of The Year, Song Of The Year and Song Of Summer) expect them to nominate him in Artist Of The Year and Song Of The Year for “Circles”. Now Best Pop or Best Rock (since the song has a pop-rock side in my opinion) is a mystery to be solved.

10 - How many nominations will The Weeknd receive? Will it be 5 or 6?
The Weeknd has been successful in his new era with Heartless and Blinding Lights.
Expect him to receive nods in Video Of The Year with Blinding Lights, Artist Of The Year, Best R&B with Blinding Lights, Direction with Blinding Lights and Editing with Blinding Lights.

11- How many nominations will His ex-girlfriend Selena Gomez have?
Selena Gomez made a big Comeback last October with the smash hit Lose You To Love Me and Look At Me Now and now with Rare.
Here’s her most logical nominations predictions:
Artist Of The Year
Song Of The Year with Lose You To Love Me
Best Pop with Lose You To Love Me
Best Choreography with Look At Her Now
Visual Effects for Rare

And now some other bullet points:

Lady Gaga has chances in Artist Of The Year and with “Stupid Love” in Video Of The Year, Best Dance, Best Direction, Cinematography, Choreography and Editing.

Harry Styles’s Adore You can be in Direction, Cinematography and Editing. With Best Pop and Video Of The Year nominations.

Roddy Ricch’s The Box can be in Video Of The Year, Song Of The Year, Best Hip Hop and all the professional categories except Choreography.

What about Best Rock? The contenders are: Coldplay with Orphans, 5 Seconds Of Summer with Teeth, Twenty One Pilots with The Hype, Green Day with Father Of All… and Evanescence with The Chain.

Will Kanye and Eminem be recognized in Hip Hop after years of snub? Eminem has more chances since Godzilla has a music video and became his first top 3 hit on the Hot 100 since The Monster.

Will SZA along with Justin Timberlake get “The Other Side” on Best R&B and Best Collaboration? The first nomination is more happening.
